presentation.chiefComplaint: Increasing shortness of breath for 10 days, now also when lying flat
presentation.history: Breathless after a few steps, now sleeps on three pillows and wakes up at night short of breath. Both ankles swollen, gained about 3 kg in one week. Dry cough at night, no fever, no chest pain, no coloured sputum. Known atrial fibrillation, hypertension and a heart attack years ago. Stopped her water tablets two weeks ago because of frequent urination. Never smoked.
observations: T 36.9°C, BP 158/92, HR 104 irregular, RR 24, SpO2 90% on room air
Fine crackles over both lung bases, jugular venous pressure raised
Pitting oedema of both legs up to mid-shin
